//: The career (M6 phase E; app/career.ts). Your player plays doubles with a partner from the lower half of the roster, through a season of tournaments in five tiers. tiers: in order; level is the AI level of the matches (data/ai-skill.json via MatchSetup.level); size is the draw (pairs, yours among them; the roster fills what it can, byes for the rest) and pick which pros fill it (weakest: the weakest of the roster by level, strongest: the strongest, any: dealt from all of them); entry is the ranking points needed to enter (masters: a place in the top `top` of the ranking instead); points are the ranking points counted back from the title (last): the final lost, the semi-final, the quarter-final, so a smaller draw starts further along; length is the match length. season: the events in order; you play each one you can enter or pass it. Ranking: your points are every event of the last `rolling` you played (the current season and the one before, halved when a season ends); a pro's points come from their roster level, `pro.base + (level - pro.from) * pro.perLevel`. partners: the share of the roster (weakest first) who will partner you at the start, and the tier from which anyone will. arenas: the secret arenas (data/arenas.json) and the career rule that opens each (data/cosmetics.json careerTier / careerTitle); until then the menus don't list them. chemistry (0..1, per partner): starts at `start`, `perMatch` more for each match played together and `perWin` more for each won, up to 1; the sim reads it as the pair's chemistry (MatchConfig.chemistry: 0.5 is the AI as everyone else meets it).
